name: Kōnan (Kagawa, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kōnan town emblem in yellow: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a triangle.
history: Flag of the former town of Kōnan in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-10. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 September 1959.

features.role: Kōnan town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a triangle
